designRead: A native-feeling Adobe workstation panel: restrained, compact, precise, task-focused, and operated Quick-first with host-persistent Live Controls.
referenceUse: Infer density, navigation, parameter-row behavior and compact tool access. Never clone branding, assets or exact layouts.

navigation.secondary: small top tabs only when switching product areas
navigation.details: show parameters for one active tool at a time

banned: persistent asset gallery on the tools dashboard
more than one accent color in UI chrome
timeline preview unless the active feature requires timing
approvedDirection: 2026-10-03: Onyx #121212, raised #1A1A1A, controls #212121, hover #2E2E2E, deep graphics #101010. System font 11–14 px, 28 px controls, 24 px minimum targets, 2/4/6 px radii. Preserve compact icon grid, GM improvements and one-click workflows. TypeScript Light DOM moti-* factories share native fallbacks. Settings: Interface, Accessibility, Help. Technical support inside Help; online account deferred. 2026-10-07 Onyx Vivo: livelier but bounded motion (tile lift/press, ripple, delayed spinner, drawn check, light overshoot on entering surfaces only, directional view changes, capped grid cascade), in-panel color picker, one-row footers with a More actions menu.
tokenMirrors: Generated by sync-theme.mjs during build; never edit mirror values manually.
